evidence: With empty title, task.form.submit enabled=false; after typing whitespace-only "   ", submit remains enabled=false. Task list unchanged (5 active).
Created "QA Alpha Task"; it appears in active list and active count went 5 -> 6 (summary "6 active, 2 completed").

Created with title "QA Alpha Task", description "Alpha description text", deadline 2026-09-05, High priority, prerequisite "Buy groceries". Card shows: QA Alpha Task / High / Alpha description text / Sep 5 / Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete.

Sort=Deadline order: Buy groceries (Tomorrow/Aug 28), Review project proposal (Aug 29), Submit final report (Sep 1), Schedule dentist (Sep 3), QA Alpha (Sep 5), Complete tax filing (Sep 10), then QA NoDeadline Task (no deadline) last.
Sort=Priority order: 4 High tasks (QA Alpha, Review project proposal, Complete tax filing, Submit final report), then 2 Medium (QA NoDeadline, Schedule dentist), then Low (Buy groceries).

issue: Blocked task cannot be edited at all; description and priority are not modifiable
actual: On blocked task "QA Alpha Task" (prereq "Buy groceries" incomplete) the edit button is `disabled` (edit.enabled=false) and clicking it times out — the edit form never opens. DOM scan of the blocked task card shows only three controls: complete (disabled), edit (disabled), delete (enabled). There is no inline or alternative control for description or priority, so the required "description and priority remain editable while title and deadline are locked" behavior is entirely absent.

evidence: Blocked tasks (QA Alpha, Complete tax filing, Submit final report) report complete.state="blocked" vs "active", carry a blocked-warning element, and complete.enabled=false (completion unavailable).

Single-prereq blocked tasks show 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete' / 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'; multi-prereq task "Submit final report" shows "2 prerequisites incomplete".

Assigned two prerequisites (Schedule dentist appointment, Buy groceries) to "QA Edited Task"; saved task shows blocked state with "2 prerequisites incomplete". Earlier single-prereq assignment on QA Alpha Task also retained.

Edited unblocked "QA NoDeadline Task" -> title "QA Edited Task", description "Edited description", deadline Sep 20, priority Low, added 2 prerequisites; all retained after save. Deleted "QA Alpha Task": removed from list, active count 7 -> 6.

Hover on "Complete tax filing" warning -> tooltip "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal / pending". Hover on "Submit final report" warning -> "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal pending / Complete tax filing pending".

Dashed SVG connectors (stroke-dasharray 6,4) render between dependent tasks with pointer-events-auto hover groups. Hovering one opened a tooltip: "Dependency Chain / QA Edited Task pending / Schedule dentist appointment pending / Buy groceries pending" — chain plus per-task completion state.

Editing "Review project proposal" (task 1): prerequisite list offers only QA Edited Task, Schedule dentist, Buy groceries, Organize desk, Reply to client emails. It omits itself, its direct dependent "Complete tax filing" (4 -> 1), and its indirect dependent "Submit final report" (7 -> 4 -> 1), so no direct or transitive cycle can be selected.

Completed "Review project proposal": removed from active list, counts moved from "6 active, 2 completed" to "5 active, 3 completed", and it appears in the completed view with complete.state="completed".

Active toggle (selected) lists exactly the 5 active tasks and reads "Active 5"; Completed toggle lists exactly the 3 completed tasks (Review project proposal, Reply to client emails, Organize desk) and reads "Completed 3". Summary "5 active, 3 completed" matches.
After completion, "Review project proposal" still exists in the completed view with its edit/delete/complete-toggle controls available; it was not deleted.

Cards show title + priority badge always; description and deadline shown only when supplied (QA NoDeadline Task showed neither); blocked tasks expose a prerequisite warning ('Prerequisite "X" incomplete' / "N prerequisites incomplete"); completed task title carries line-through text-muted-foreground and card bg-muted/50, distinguishing it from active tasks.

"Complete tax filing" had complete.enabled=false (disabled button) while prereq "Review project proposal" was incomplete. After completing that prereq it became active with an enabled complete toggle and "1 prerequisite completed", and completing it succeeded. Same pattern for "Submit final report" (blocked -> active, "2 prerequisites completed").

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves its dependent simultaneously completed and blocked, and irreversibly stuck
actual: Completed "Review project proposal" (prereq), then completed its dependent "Complete tax filing". Reopening "Review project proposal" was allowed with no prompt or cascade. "Complete tax filing" now sits in the COMPLETED view with data-semtag-state="completed" and line-through styling, while simultaneously rendering the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'. Its complete toggle is disabled (completeDisabled=true) and its edit button is disabled, so the user cannot reopen or fix it — the task is permanently locked in the contradictory completed+blocked state. The system neither prevented the reopen nor returned the dependent to a valid incomplete state.
